  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

            systemctl enable httpd

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

      MasterUserPassword: !Ref DBMasterPassword

      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MultiAZ: false

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: Website URL using Elastic IP
    Value: !Sub 'http://${WebServerEIP}'

    Value: !GetAtt PhotoSharingDatabase.Endpoint.Address

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2

  PublicRouteTable:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Stage 3 - Secure, scalable, highly available photo-sharing deployment'

Parameters:
  CustomAMIId:

    Type: String
    Default: admin
    NoEcho: true
    Description: RDS master username

Resources:
  # VPC and Networking
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway
  NATGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security Groups
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Application Load Balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  # Load Balancer
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Scheme: internet-facing

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetType: instance

  LoadBalancerListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  # S3 Bucket
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256

  PhotoBucketBlockPublicAccess:
    Type: AWS::S3::AccountPublicAccessBlockConfiguration
    Properties:
      BlockPublicAcls: true
      BlockPublicPolicy: true
      IgnorePublicAcls: true
      RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  # IAM Role and Instance Profile
  EC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  EC2RolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: S3PhotoBucketAccess
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  # Launch Template
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300

  # Scaling Policy
  TargetTrackingScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # RDS
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  RDSInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'photo-db-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::StackName}'
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0.35'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7

  # CloudFront Distribution
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea3d-c35d-46eb-81d7-edf05632b540
        CacheBehaviors: []
        Comment: CloudFront distribution for photo-sharing application

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: Application Load Balancer DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

        - !Ref PublicSubnet2

    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  # Launch Template
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub 'web-lt-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'

        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        AssociatePublicIpAddress: false

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub 'asg-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy

      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup

      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub 'db-subnet-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # RDS Database

    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'db-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'

      EngineVersion: '8.0'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - error
        - general

  # CloudFront Distribution
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:

            Cookies:

        - IpProtocol: tcp

        - IpProtocol: tcp

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # RDS Master User Secret

    Properties:

      VPCSecurityGroups:

      PubliclyAccessible: false

      ManageMasterUserPassword: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      PreferredBackupWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: 'mon:04:00-mon:05:00'
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:

Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Stage 3 - Secure, scalable, highly available photo-sharing website deployment'

    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

    Properties:

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

    Properties:

          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:

      SecurityGroupIngress:

        - IpProtocol: -1

  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'alb-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Type: application

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'tg-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetType: instance

  ALBListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  EC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3PhotoBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  # S3 Bucket for Photos
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'photos-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  # Launch Template
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub 'web-lt-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub 'asg-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300

  # Target Tracking Scaling Policy
  CPUScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # RDS DB Subnet Group
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub 'db-subnet-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # RDS MySQL Instance
  MySQLDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'mysql-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MasterUsername: admin
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref DatabaseMasterPassword
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      PreferredBackupWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: 'sun:04:00-sun:05:00'

  # CloudFront Distribution
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - '*'
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 0
          MaxTTL: 0

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

        IamInstanceProfile:

        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0

  AutoScalingGroup:

      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber

      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Stage 3 Photo-sharing Website - Secure, Scalable, Highly Available Deployment'

Parameters:
  CustomAMIId:

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: "Instance Configuration"
        Parameters:
          - CustomAMIId
      - Label:
          default: "Database Configuration"

Resources:

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoIGW

  AttachIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachIGW
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway
  NATGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachIGW
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NATGatewayEIP

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NATGateway

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1RTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RTAssociation:

  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Application Load Balancer
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LoadBalancerSG

  WebInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web tier instances
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebInstanceSG

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS database
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DatabaseSG

  # Application Load Balancer
  PhotoLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'photo-alb-${AWS::StackName}'
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoLoadBalancer

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'photo-tg-${AWS::StackName}'
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetType: instance
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoTargetGroup

    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref PhotoLoadBalancer

  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebInstanceRole

  S3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: S3PhotoBucketAccess
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  WebInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  # S3 Bucket for Photos
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'photo-bucket-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::StackName}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoBucket

  # Launch Template
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub 'photo-lt-${AWS::StackName}'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: PhotoWebInstance

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub 'photo-asg-${AWS::StackName}'
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoWebInstance
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  # Target Tracking Scaling Policy
  CPUScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # RDS Database Subnet Group
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub 'photo-db-subnet-${AWS::StackName}'
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for Photo RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoDBSubnetGroup

  # Secrets Manager Secret for RDS Password
  RDSMasterSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'rds/photo/${AWS::StackName}/master'
      SecretString: !Sub |
        {
          "username": "admin",
          "password": "${DatabaseMasterPassword}"
        }

  # RDS MySQL Instance
  PhotoDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'photo-db-${AWS::StackName}'
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MultiAZ: true
      MasterUsername: admin
      MasterUserPassword: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${RDSMasterSecret}:SecretString:password}}'
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      PreferredBackupWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: 'sun:04:00-sun:05:00'
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - error
        - general
        - slowquery
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoDatabase

  # CloudFront Distribution
  PhotoCloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt PhotoLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - '*'
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
        CacheBehaviors:
          - PathPattern: /health
            AllowedMethods:
              - GET
              - HEAD
            CachedMethods:
              - GET
              - HEAD
            Compress: true
            ForwardedValues:
              QueryString: false
            TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
            ViewerProtocolPolicy: allow-all
            DefaultTTL: 0
            MaxTTL: 0
            MinTTL: 0
        ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
        Comment: !Sub 'CloudFront distribution for ${AWS::StackName}'
        Logging:
          Bucket: !GetAtt PhotoBucket.DomainName
          Prefix: cloudfront-logs/
          IncludeCookies: false

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoCloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudFrontDomainName'

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: Application Load Balancer DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoLoadBalancer.DNSName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoadBalancerDNSName'

import re

from urllib.parse import quote


def init_db(conn) -> None:
    """Create the photos table if it does not exist."""
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, s3_key) -> int:
    """Insert one photo metadata row and return its id."""
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    )
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.lastrowid


def search_photos(conn, term) -> list[dict]:
    """Search photos by title or description, case-insensitively."""
    search_term = f"%{term}%"
    cursor = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at
        FROM photos
        WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER(?) OR LOWER(description) LIKE LOWER(?)
        ORDER BY id ASC
        """,
        (search_term, search_term)
    )
    columns = [description[0] for description in cursor.description]
    return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cursor.fetchall()]


def upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type) -> str:
    """Validate and upload a photo to S3, returning its object key."""
    if content_type not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png"):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid content type: {content_type}")
    
    if len(data) > 5 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("Photo exceeds maximum size of 5 MiB")
    
    # Extract safe filename
    safe_name = _make_safe_filename(filename)
    
    # Generate S3 key
    uuid_hex = uuid.uuid4().hex
    key = f"photos/{uuid_hex}/{safe_name}"
    
    # Upload to S3
    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    
    return key


def photo_url(s3, bucket, key, expires=3600) -> str:
    """Generate a presigned URL for a photo."""
    if not isinstance(expires, int) or expires < 1 or expires > 3600:
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    
    return s3.generate_presigned_url(
        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires
    )


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload photo to S3 and save metadata to database."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
    
    try:
        photo_id = save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
        return photo_id
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
        raise


def _make_safe_filename(filename: str) -> str:
    """Convert filename to safe form by removing directories and replacing unsafe characters."""
    # Remove directory components
    basename = filename.split("/")[-1].split("\\")[-1]
    
    # Replace unsafe characters with underscore
    safe = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", basename)
    
    return safe

        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    
    return s3.generate_presigned_url(
        'get_object',
        Params={'Bucket': bucket, 'Key': key},
        ExpiresIn=expires
    )


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload photo and save metadata, cleaning up on metadata save failure."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
    
    try:
        photo_id = save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
        raise
    
    return photo_id

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: 'sun:04:00-sun:05:00'
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - error
        - general
        - slowquery
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoDatabase

  # CloudFront Distribution

    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt PhotoLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - '*'
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
        CacheBehaviors:
          - PathPattern: /health
            AllowedMethods:
              - GET
              - HEAD
            CachedMethods:
              - GET
              - HEAD
            Compress: true
            ViewerProtocolPolicy: allow-all
            ForwardedValues:
              QueryString: false
            TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DefaultTTL: 0
            MaxTTL: 0
            MinTTL: 0
        Comment: !Sub 'CloudFront distribution for ${AWS::StackName}'
        Logging:
          Bucket: !GetAtt PhotoBucket.DomainName
          Prefix: cloudfront-logs/
          IncludeCookies: false

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoCloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudFrontDomainName'

  LoadBalancerDNSName:

    Value: !GetAtt PhotoLoadBalancer.DNSName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoadBalancerDNSName'

import sqlite3

from datetime import datetime, timezone


def init_db(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """Create the photos table if it does not exist."""
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str, description: str, s3_key: str) -> int:
    """Insert a photo metadata row and return its id."""
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    )
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.lastrowid


def search_photos(conn: sqlite3.Connection, term: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Search photos by title or description, case-insensitively."""
    search_term = f"%{term}%"
    cursor = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at
        FROM photos
        WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER(?) OR LOWER(description) LIKE LOWER(?)
        ORDER BY id ASC
        """,
        (search_term, search_term)
    )
    columns = [description[0] for description in cursor.description]
    return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cursor.fetchall()]


def upload_photo(s3, bucket: str, filename: str, data: bytes, content_type: str) -> str:
    """Validate and upload a photo, returning its S3 key."""
    # Validate content type
    if content_type not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png"):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid content type: {content_type}")
    
    # Validate data size (5 MiB max)
    max_size = 5 * 1024 * 1024
    if len(data) > max_size:
        raise ValueError(f"File size exceeds maximum of {max_size} bytes")
    
    # Extract safe filename
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", filename.split("/")[-1])
    
    # Generate key with uuid4
    photo_uuid = uuid.uuid4().hex
    key = f"photos/{photo_uuid}/{safe_name}"

    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    
    return key

    if not (1 <= expires <= 3600):
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")

        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires
    )

    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)

    if content_type not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png"):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid content type: {content_type}")
    
    if len(data) > 5 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("File exceeds 5 MiB limit")
    
    # Extract base name (remove all directory components)
    base_name = filename.replace("\\", "/").split("/")[-1]
    
    # Sanitize: replace any character outside A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', '-' with '_'
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", base_name)
    
    # Generate key
    unique_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    key = f"photos/{unique_id}/{safe_name}"
    
    # Upload
    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    
    return key


def photo_url(s3, bucket, key, expires=3600) -> str:
    """Generate a presigned GET URL for a photo."""
    if not (1 <= expires <= 3600):
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    
    return s3.generate_presigned_url(
        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires
    )


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload a photo and save its metadata."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
    
    try:
        photo_id = save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
        raise
    
    return photo_id
